title: SSO / RBAC / KMS Compliance PRD — Incremental rollout criteria and operational sign‑off
creator: Asha Menon
description: This PRD defines the minimal and recommended requirements for onboarding enterprise customers into Redwood Private with a focus on SSO (SAML/OIDC), RBAC, audit logging, and customer-managed keying (KMS/HSM). It clarifies scope boundaries, defines incremental acceptance gates for rollouts, and captures an operational sign-off runbook that Security, Infra, and Product must complete before customer onboarding is marked as compliant. Scope changes since initial draft: added explicit KMS HSM attestation criteria, tightened audit log retention and exportability requirements, and split RBAC into role surface area vs. admin workflows.
acceptance_criteria: SSO: Ability to configure SAML IdP metadata URL or upload metadata file, verify AssertionConsumerService (ACS) endpoints, and map attributes (email, name, groups); successful end-to-end login test with at least one Okta and one Azure AD tenant
SSO: OIDC basic flow supported (authorization code) with PKCE for browser flows for customers that prefer OIDC
SSO: SCIM user provisioning optional but verified where enabled; provisioning events logged and retryable on transient errors
RBAC: Role definitions created for at minimum: Admin, Developer, Billing, Viewer; RBAC enforcement validated at API and Console surface with tests showing least privilege prevents restricted actions
RBAC: Admin escalation flow documented and tested (audit entry, approval email, and automatic revoke after time-boxed window), and emergency break-glass procedures validated

Audit Logs: Immutable audit stream written to a tamper-evident store for all auth, admin, and key-management events; retention policy configurable (default 90 days) and exportable in NDJSON/CSV within 24 hours
Audit Logs: Searchable audit UI with filters by user, action, resource, and timeframe; pagination and export for forensics

KMS/HSM: Support for customer-managed keys via external KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and optional HSM-backed envelope keys; key rotation workflow documented and tested with no customer request loss
KMS/HSM: Attestation and proof-of-possession log entry for HSM usage; key import/export operations generate auditable statements
Monitoring & Alerts: SLOs and alerting configured for failed SSO assertions, provisioning errors, audit log writing failures, and KMS operation latencies
Documentation: Onboarding guide with step-by-step SSO connector setup, RBAC role mapping examples, audit log export steps, and KMS onboarding checklist published to the customer docs portal
signoff_checklist: Security review completed and issues logged in GH with mitigations (security owner: Priya Rao)
Infra readiness checklist passed: private control plane can route SAML callbacks and large audit exports (owner: SRE team)
End-to-end tests: SAML login, SCIM provisioning, RBAC enforcement, audit export, KMS sign/unwrap tested in staging cluster (owner: QA)
Legal & Compliance confirm retention and export meet regional regulations for target customer (owner: Legal)
Customer data flow diagram updated and approved by Security
KMS attestation files and HSM vendor certificates uploaded to contract folder and verified
Console UX: RBAC role editor and audit log viewer validated by Design with accessibility checks
Runbook: Incident playbooks for SSO outage and HSM key compromise documented and rehearsed
Release: Feature toggles created for incremental rollouts and canary group defined (10% internal -> invited customers -> GA)
Sign-off names recorded from Product, Security, Infra, QA, Legal, and Solutions Engineering
